posts.title: The Windows Modern Standby Conundrum: When Sleep Isn't Really Sleep
posts.description: Have you ever put your laptop to “sleep” only to find it wide awake later? You’re not alone. Modern Windows machines have a feature called Modern Standby that has changed the game - and not always for the better. The Unexpected Wake-Up Call Recently, I experienced a rude awakening: my Windows 11 laptop’s fans were running at FULL SEND despite the lid being closed. This wasn’t an isolated incident.
